overstory.eyebrow: The Overstory · what every account hears
overstory.headline: Finding was never the problem. Fixing is.

pillars.p: The backlog, not the unknown, is the risk.
Security finds. IT fixes. Fixes die in the handoff.

landing.hero_eyebrow: Prepared by David Aaronson for Remedio
landing.hero_lede: Run it against your own backlog. It qualifies, segments, and writes the champion's business case. Nobody fills out a form. Behavior routes each account to its play.
landing.cta_secondary: For sellers: run the deep diagnostic

gap_assessment.intro_headline: Show us where the queue lives.
gap_assessment.intro_lede: Not a form. Click the sentences that describe your day. We route from there.
gap_assessment.step_pain_headline: Click every sentence that sounds like your week.
gap_assessment.step_pain_subtitle: Pick as many as apply. Skip anything that doesn't. Behavior segments better than a checkbox tree.
gap_assessment.step_hard_subtitle: Enough to shape the output. Nothing personal, nothing you'd hesitate to share.
gap_assessment.step_output_subtitle: Written for the champion inside your org. Forward it. The share link keeps your inputs.

current_stack.label: What's in your stack today?
current_stack.hint: Add any tool that isn't listed. This is the freelancing that killed the last web version. Not this one.

share.note: This link carries your inputs. Send it to your CFO or CIO — they'll see the same output.
